finance_expenses_reversal_check.name: finance_expenses_reversal_check
finance_expenses_reversal_check.value: ("finance_expenses"."entry_type" = 'EXPENSE' AND "finance_expenses"."reverses_expense_id" IS NULL) OR ("finance_expenses"."entry_type" = 'REVERSAL' AND "finance_expenses"."reverses_expense_id" IS NOT NULL)

finance_sale_lines_money_check.name: finance_sale_lines_money_check
finance_sale_lines_money_check.value: "finance_sale_lines"."unit_price_real" >= 0 AND "finance_sale_lines"."gross_income" >= 0 AND "finance_sale_lines"."allocated_discount" >= 0 AND "finance_sale_lines"."net_income" >= 0 AND ("finance_sale_lines"."historical_unit_cost" IS NULL OR "finance_sale_lines"."historical_unit_cost" >= 0) AND ("finance_sale_lines"."historical_cogs" IS NULL OR "finance_sale_lines"."historical_cogs" >= 0)

finance_sales_money_check.name: finance_sales_money_check
finance_sales_money_check.value: "finance_sales"."product_gross_total" >= 0 AND "finance_sales"."discount_total" >= 0 AND "finance_sales"."product_net_total" >= 0 AND "finance_sales"."delivery_income" >= 0 AND "finance_sales"."total_income" >= 0 AND ("finance_sales"."historical_cogs_total" IS NULL OR "finance_sales"."historical_cogs_total" >= 0)

notification_preferences_boolean_check.name: notification_preferences_boolean_check
notification_preferences_boolean_check.value: "notification_preferences"."push_enabled" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."low_stock_enabled" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."out_of_stock_enabled" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."orders_enabled" IN (0,1) AND "notification_preferences"."special_orders_enabled" IN (0,1)

order_payments_reversal_check.name: order_payments_reversal_check
order_payments_reversal_check.value: ("order_payments"."payment_type" = 'PAYMENT' AND "order_payments"."reverses_payment_id" IS NULL) OR ("order_payments"."payment_type" <> 'PAYMENT' AND "order_payments"."reverses_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(COALESCE("order_payments"."reason",''))) >= 3)
